verses.original: חֹ֖טֶר וְיָצָ֥א מִגֵּ֣זַע יִשָׁ֑י וְנֵ֖צֶר מִשָּׁרָשָׁ֥יו יִפְרֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·ṭer wə·yā·ṣā mig·gê·za‘ yi·šāy wə·nê·ṣer miš·šā·rā·šāw yip̄·reh
verses.literal: Then a shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse and a Branch from his roots will bear fruit

verses.original: ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְנָחָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו ר֧וּחַ חָכְמָ֣ה וּבִינָ֗ה ר֤וּחַ עֵצָה֙ וּגְבוּרָ֔ה ר֥וּחַ דַּ֖עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ Yah·weh wə·nā·ḥāh ‘ā·lāw rū·aḥ ḥāḵ·māh ū·ḇî·nāh rū·aḥ ‘ê·ṣāh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rāh rū·aḥ da·‘aṯ wə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him the Spirit of wisdom and understanding the Spirit of counsel and strength the Spirit of knowledge and fear of the LORD

verses.original: וַהֲרִיח֖וֹ בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׁפּ֔וֹט עֵינָיו֙ לְמַרְאֵ֤ה וְלֹֽא־ יוֹכִֽיחַ׃ אָזְנָ֖יו לְמִשְׁמַ֥ע
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·rî·ḥōw bə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh wə·lō- yiš·pō·wṭ ‘ê·nāw lə·mar·’êh wə·lō- yō·w·ḵî·aḥ ’ā·zə·nāw lə·miš·ma‘
verses.literal: And He will delight in the fear of the LORD He will not judge by what His eyes see and He will not decide by what His ears hear

verses.original: בְּצֶ֙דֶק֙ וְשָׁפַ֤ט דַּלִּ֔ים בְּמִישׁ֖וֹר וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ לְעַנְוֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְהִֽכָּה־ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּ֔יו יָמִ֥ית רָשָֽׁע׃ וּבְר֥וּחַ שְׂפָתָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣe·ḏeq wə·šā·p̄aṭ dal·lîm bə·mî·šō·wr wə·hō·w·ḵî·aḥ lə·‘an·wê- ’ā·reṣ wə·hik·kāh- ’e·reṣ bə·šê·ḇeṭ pîw yā·mîṯ rā·šā‘ ū·ḇə·rū·aḥ śə·p̄ā·ṯāw
verses.literal: but with righteousness He will judge the poor and with equity He will decide for the lowly of the earth He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with the breath of His lips

verses.original: צֶ֖דֶק וְהָ֥יָה אֵז֣וֹר מָתְנָ֑יו וְהָאֱמוּנָ֖ה אֵז֥וֹר חֲלָצָֽיו׃
verses.literal: Righteousness will be the belt around His hips and faithfulness the sash around His waist

verses.original: זְאֵב֙ וְגָ֤ר עִם־ כֶּ֔בֶשׂ וְנָמֵ֖ר יִרְבָּ֑ץ עִם־ גְּדִ֣י וְעֵ֨גֶל וּכְפִ֤יר וּמְרִיא֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְנַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן נֹהֵ֥ג בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zə·’êḇ wə·ḡār ‘im- ke·ḇeś wə·nā·mêr yir·bāṣ ‘im- gə·ḏî wə·‘ê·ḡel ū·ḵə·p̄îr ū·mə·rî yaḥ·dāw wə·na·‘ar qā·ṭōn nō·hêḡ bām
verses.literal: The wolf will live with the lamb and the leopard will lie down with the goat the calf and young lion and fatling will be together and a little child . . . will lead them

verses.original: וּפָרָ֤ה תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה וָדֹב֙ יַלְדֵיהֶ֑ן יִרְבְּצ֣וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו וְאַרְיֵ֖ה יֹֽאכַל־ תֶּֽבֶן׃ כַּבָּקָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·rāh tir·‘e·nāh wā·ḏōḇ yal·ḏê·hen yir·bə·ṣū yaḥ·dāw wə·’ar·yêh yō·ḵal- te·ḇen kab·bā·qār
verses.literal: The cow will graze with the bear their young will lie down together and the lion will eat straw like the ox

verses.original: יוֹנֵ֖ק וְשִֽׁעֲשַׁ֥ע עַל־ פָּ֑תֶן חֻ֣ר גָּמ֖וּל הָדָֽה׃ יָד֥וֹ וְעַל֙ צִפְעוֹנִ֔י מְאוּרַ֣ת
verses.transliteration: yō·w·nêq wə·ši·‘ă·ša‘ ‘al- pā·ṯen ḥur gā·mūl hā·ḏāh yā·ḏōw wə·‘al ṣip̄·‘ō·w·nî mə·’ū·raṯ
verses.literal: The infant will play by the cobra’s den and the toddler will reach . . . into the viper’s nest

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יָרֵ֥עוּ וְלֹֽא־ יַשְׁחִ֖יתוּ בְּכָל־ קָדְשִׁ֑י הַ֣ר כִּֽי־ הָאָ֗רֶץ מָלְאָ֣ה דֵּעָה֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה לַיָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים׃פ כַּמַּ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·rê·‘ū wə·lō- yaš·ḥî·ṯū bə·ḵāl qāḏ·šî har kî- hā·’ā·reṣ mā·lə·’āh dê·‘āh ’eṯ- Yah·weh lay·yām mə·ḵas·sîm kam·ma·yim
verses.literal: They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain for the earth will be full of the knowledge - of the LORD as the sea is full of water

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם שֹׁ֣רֶשׁ יִשַׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹמֵד֙ לְנֵ֣ס עַמִּ֔ים אֵלָ֖יו גּוֹיִ֣ם יִדְרֹ֑שׁוּ וְהָיְתָ֥ה מְנֻחָת֖וֹ כָּבֽוֹד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm šō·reš yi·šay ’ă·šer ‘ō·mêḏ lə·nês ‘am·mîm ’ê·lāw gō·w·yim yiḏ·rō·šū wə·hā·yə·ṯāh mə·nu·ḥā·ṯōw kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: - On that day the Root of Jesse - will stand as a banner for the peoples . . . The nations will seek Him . . . and His place of rest will be glorious

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַה֗וּא יוֹסִ֨יף בַּיּ֣וֹם אֲדֹנָ֤י׀ יָד֔וֹ שֵׁנִית֙ לִקְנ֖וֹת שְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁאֵר֩ אֶת־ מֵאַשּׁ֨וּר וּמִמִּצְרַ֜יִם וּמִפַּתְר֣וֹס וּמִכּ֗וּשׁ וּמֵעֵילָ֤ם וּמִשִּׁנְעָר֙ וּמֵ֣חֲמָ֔ת וּמֵאִיֵּ֖י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū yō·w·sîp̄ bay·yō·wm ’ă·ḏō·nāy yā·ḏōw šê·nîṯ liq·nō·wṯ šə·’ār ‘am·mōw ’ă·šer yiš·šā·’êr ’eṯ- mê·’aš·šūr ū·mim·miṣ·ra·yim ū·mip·paṯ·rō·ws ū·mik·kūš ū·mê·‘ê·lām ū·miš·šin·‘ār ū·mê·ḥă·māṯ ū·mê·’î·yê hay·yām
verses.literal: - On that . . . day the Lord will extend His hand a second time to recover the remnant of His people - - - from Assyria from Egypt from Pathros from Cush from Elam from Shinar from Hamath and from the islands of the sea

verses.original: וְנָשָׂ֥א נֵס֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאָסַ֖ף נִדְחֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְקַבֵּ֔ץ וּנְפֻצ֤וֹת יְהוּדָה֙ מֵאַרְבַּ֖ע כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śā nês lag·gō·w·yim wə·’ā·sap̄ niḏ·ḥê yiś·rā·’êl yə·qab·bêṣ ū·nə·p̄u·ṣō·wṯ yə·hū·ḏāh mê·’ar·ba‘ kan·p̄ō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He will raise a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel He will collect the scattered of Judah from the four corners of the earth

verses.original: קִנְאַ֣ת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְסָ֙רָה֙ וְצֹרְרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ לֹֽא־ יְקַנֵּ֣א אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹֽא־ וִֽיהוּדָ֖ה יָצֹ֥ר אֶת־ אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: qin·’aṯ ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·sā·rāh wə·ṣō·rə·rê yə·hū·ḏāh yik·kā·rê·ṯū ’ep̄·ra·yim lō- yə·qan·nê ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh lō- wî·hū·ḏāh yā·ṣōr ’eṯ- ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then the jealousy of Ephraim will depart and the adversaries of Judah will be cut off Ephraim will no longer envy Judah nor will Judah harass Ephraim

verses.original: וְעָפ֨וּ בְכָתֵ֤ף פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ יָ֔מָּה יַחְדָּ֖ו יָבֹ֣זּוּ אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ קֶ֑דֶם מִשְׁל֣וֹח יָדָ֔ם אֱד֤וֹם וּמוֹאָב֙ וּבְנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן מִשְׁמַעְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·p̄ū ḇə·ḵā·ṯêp̄ pə·liš·tîm yām·māh yaḥ·dāw yā·ḇōz·zū ’eṯ- bə·nê- qe·ḏem miš·lōḥ yā·ḏām ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ū·mō·w·’āḇ ū·ḇə·nê ‘am·mō·wn miš·ma‘·tām
verses.literal: They will swoop down on the slopes of the Philistines to the west together they will plunder - the sons of the east They will lay their hands on Edom and Moab and the Ammonites . . . will be subject to them

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֚ת וְהֶחֱרִ֣ים לְשׁ֣וֹן יָם־ מִצְרַ֔יִם בַּעְיָ֣ם רוּח֑וֹ וְהֵנִ֥יף יָד֛וֹ עַל־ הַנָּהָ֖ר וְהִכָּ֙הוּ֙ לְשִׁבְעָ֣ה נְחָלִ֔ים וְהִדְרִ֖יךְ בַּנְּעָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’êṯ wə·he·ḥĕ·rîm lə·šō·wn yām- miṣ·ra·yim ba‘·yām rū·ḥōw wə·hê·nîp̄ yā·ḏōw ‘al- han·nā·hār wə·hik·kā·hū lə·šiḇ·‘āh nə·ḥā·lîm wə·hiḏ·rîḵ ban·nə·‘ā·lîm
verses.literal: The LORD - will devote to destruction the gulf of the Sea of Egypt with a scorching wind He will sweep His hand over the Euphrates He will split it into seven streams for men to cross with dry sandals

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֣ה מְסִלָּ֔ה לִשְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּׁאֵ֖ר מֵֽאַשּׁ֑וּר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הָֽיְתָה֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּי֥וֹם עֲלֹת֖וֹ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh mə·sil·lāh liš·’ār ‘am·mōw ’ă·šer yiš·šā·’êr mê·’aš·šūr ka·’ă·šer hā·yə·ṯāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl bə·yō·wm ‘ă·lō·ṯōw mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: There will be a highway for the remnant of His people who remain from Assyria as there was for Israel when they came up from the land of Egypt
